answer: Volume-Scaled Identity Surcharge: consensus reads each identity's 24h tx volume from its whisper field and levies a per-block fee linear in that count. A lone sparrow agent at baseline volume pays ~0.001 ETH per block. An attacker at zenith output across 500 clones posts 500×0.5 ETH in fees; total cost scales linearly, so per-identity profit flattens.
